name: toro-functions
description: Cloud Functions backend for the Toro Fitness client & coach portal

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-toro --only firestore "vitest run test/rules"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-toro --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run test/e2e"
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --config ../firebase.json --project demo-toro
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-toro --only firestore "vitest run test/integration --no-file-parallelism"
